curriculum.lesson_evidence: We can practise water safety skills on land with no water involved. Skills include 'Reach, throw, don't go' (reach with a stick or throw something that floats instead of going in), floating on your back on a mat, waving and calling for help, and knowing what the flags mean. Real swimming and rescue skills are taught by qualified instructors, so land practice is only a start.

lesson.guided_practice:
PRACTISE BEFORE READING THE FEEDBACK
A toy floats away from the edge of a pool and a child wants to jump in to fetch it. Write what the child should do.

FEEDBACK
Do not go in. Ask an adult for help. If a person is in trouble, call out for help and use reach or throw while staying on land. Toys can be replaced; people cannot.

WATCH FOR
Believing that a good swimmer can safely go in to rescue someone. Even strong swimmers can get into trouble; reaching or throwing and calling for help is safer.
lesson.independent_task:
INDEPENDENT EVIDENCE
With an adult, practise the three land skills (reach or throw an object, float on a mat, wave and call for help) and write the steps. Record what you would say to an adult or lifeguard and when you would call 000. Real water practice is only with a qualified instructor.

Write a short reflection naming one choice you changed and why. Any movement is optional, adult-supervised and can be done in a gentler way or described instead.

Skills include 'Reach, throw, don't go' (reach with a stick or throw something that floats instead of going in), floating on your back on a mat, waving and calling for help, and knowing what the flags mean. Real swimming and rescue skills are taught by qualified instructors, so land practice is only a start. Now choose a different situation to show you can transfer the idea.
teaching.rule: Use the same PDHPE idea in a new place, game or situation, not a copy of the example. Review safety, fairness and inclusion.
teaching.why: This helps the learner make safe, healthy and respectful choices using clear cues and reasons, rather than guessing or copying others. Every choice keeps bodies safe and includes everyone.
